commands.name: workflow
commands.code: async function main(argv, ctx) { const title = document.title; ctx.log('title', title); const [tab] = await ctx.chrome.tabs.query({ active: true, currentWindow: true }); ctx.log('tab', { title: tab?.title, url: tab?.url }); const banner = document.createElement('div'); banner.textContent = `Active tab is ${tab?.title || 'unknown'}`; banner.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;background:#111;color:#fff;padding:8px;z-index:999999;'; document.documentElement.appendChild(banner); const bookmarks = await ctx.chrome.bookmarks.search({ title }); ctx.log('bookmarks', { count: bookmarks?.length || 0 }); banner.textContent += bookmarks?.length ? ` (bookmarked x${bookmarks.length})` : ' (not bookmarked)'; }

en-US.title: workflow
en-US.body: Round-trip workflow between page and service worker.
